items.title: FY 2026 Budget Amendment - Board adopt a resolution amending the Fiscal Year 2025-2026 Budget.
FY 2027 Budget Amendment - Board adopt a resolution amending the Fiscal Year 2026-2027 Budget.
FY 2027 Public Health Services Contract - Board authorize chairman to sign the FY26/27 public health services contract for the period of October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027.

Misdemeanor Probation Services Contract - Board to approve the attached contract with Professional Probation Services, Inc., for misdemeanor probation services, and authorize the chairman to sign the same.
Ratify Purchase/Repair of Emergency Communications Equipment - Board to ratify Purchase Order POBOCC-10001207 to Williams Communications, Inc.
Purchase of Fire Engine - Board approve the purchase of a fire engine and authorize the chairman to sign the proposal.
Janitorial Services Contract Amendment - Approve Amendment No. 1 to Contract 25-11 with Executive Cleaning, Inc., increasing the annual contract amount to $56,528 for Group D Janitorial Services.
Grounds Maintenance Contract Amendment - Approve Amendment No. 2 to Contract 25-51 with Brandow’s Lawn and Landscape, removing 21 properties and reducing the contract total by $50,226 to $209,380.97.
Automatic Backwash Filter Rehab Contract - Board award Contract 26-57, Military Point Automatic Backwash Filter Rehab, to Marshall Brothers in the amount of $690,869.00.
Advanced Wastewater Treatment Plant Lease Agreement - Board award the first amendment to lease No. USAF-AETC-TYN-01-96-009 and authorize the chairman to execute the agreement.
